# Technologies
Faster-than-light drives, terraforming and artificial people have carried humanity to the stars. Most of this technology is built and owned by the great [textlink="corporations" link="CMUGuideLoreCorporations"], and who controls it shapes who controls the frontier.
- [textlink="Synthetics" link="CMUGuideLoreSynthetics"]: artificial people, built to look, act and work like humans. - [textlink="Stasis" link="CMUGuideLoreStasis"]: hypersleep, which lets crews sleep through years-long voyages. - [textlink="Powered Work Loaders" link="CMUGuideLorePowerLoaders"]: walking exoskeletons for heavy lifting. - [textlink="Atmosphere Processors" link="CMUGuideLoreAtmosProcessors"]: the towering reactors that make alien worlds breathable.
